title: Lavender Farm U-Pick Experience Bainbridge Island (Near Seattle)
includes: Access to lavender field, picnic area and forest walk
Tools you need for cutting your own lavender bundle
A sample of our Lavender Lemonade
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The property is wheel chair accessible for viewing the field only. The fields and forest trail are not fully accessible.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Make your visit to Seattle unforgettable by visiting the only Bainbridge Island lavender farm. Immerse yourself in the beauty of the Pacific Northwest with our lavender fields near Seattle and enjoy the native forest walk. We will guide you through the varieties of lavender on our farm and teach you how to snip like a pro. 

Each ticket includes a hands-on experience: cutting your own lavender bundle and learning to de-bud dried lavender. 
We encourage you to stay awhile, bring a picnic, snap photos in the field and Walk through the native forest learning as you go with our written guide. 

Enjoy a refreshing lavender lemonade on the porch while exploring the charming Farm Stand for unique, hand-made lavender products.

Whether you are traveling with friends, family, your pup or solo, Bluetree Farm and Forest is a perfect stop to do something interactive, engaging and fun! We can't wait to meet you.
